transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

I... didn't really want to be here. My family made me come. We just keep arguing because... well, they keep waving these bank papers around, saying they prove nothing was taken. 

But I know they're hiding my money. It's been over a year now. They just... they use all these things to cover it up. Like bills, or some fundraiser, or plans for a trip... just making things up to hide it. I have to keep confronting them until they tell the truth. So... yeah. I won't drop it, and that's why they wanted me here.
Have you been using any drugs or alcohol recently?
No. I don't... I don't use anything like that. Just... no.
Have you ever heard voices when no one else was around?
No. I don't... hear anything like that. Just my own thoughts.
Do you believe anyone is spying on you or trying to harm you?
No. I don't... nobody is doing that. They just have my money. That's it.
Do you think it is possible that your family is not hiding your money?

No. I don't... no. It's not possible. 

They keep saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken, but... I know. It's been over a year. They just use... bills and fundraisers and trip plans to cover it up. I know they're hiding it. I just... I have to keep confronting them until they tell the truth. That's why I came in. They just... won't tell the truth.
Do you ever think there is any chance you could be mistaken about your family hiding your money?

No. I... I'm not mistaken. I just told you. 

The papers they show me don't mean anything. I know what they're doing with the bills and... the trips. I'm not wrong about this. I just need them to tell the truth.
Have you always been this suspicious and certain that people are hiding things from you, or is this belief new?

No. It's... it's not how I always am. 

It started... well, my income dropped. That was about... a year and two months ago, I guess. That's when it started.
Has anyone ever shown you clear proof that your money was not taken?

They... they think they have. Like I just said, they show me those bank papers. My family... and my friends, too. They say it proves nothing was taken. 

But... it doesn't. I've known for over a year they're hiding it. They just use the bills and... fundraisers and trip plans to cover it all up. I just... I have to keep confronting them. Until they finally tell the truth.
Have you generally been suspicious or mistrustful of other people for most of your adult life?
No. I... I don't think so. I'm not... I don't just go around mistrusting everyone for no reason. That's not me. I just know what they're doing to me right now.
